search_domain_change: Explicit odd distances3..41 for every dynamics method; native defaults3..25 failed the full unamplified-QSP p1e-3 workload without relaxing any error/retry budget
budget_scope: Each case/profile is a separate proposed task; no simultaneous 1% guarantee across the sweep
algorithm_evidence: rational product-formula bounds with original angle-rounding accounting; QSP/OAA accepted blocks are bounded numerical checks
conditional_confidence_scope: declared ideal algorithm/acceptance evidence plus unverified mean-synthesis-TV and physical-model assumptions
QSP_physical_size_sweep: Computed n2,n3,n4 at fixed J1,h.7,t1; retargeted14/15phases, numerical circuit evidence and conditional physical model, not generic phase/size certification
dynamic_instrument_physical_estimation: excluded; no reset or intermediate-measurement work was omitted from an imported trial
included: explicit Hamiltonian gates and input basis preparation
all final data and ancillary measurements
all capped attempts including rejected trials
surface-code layout and magic-state factories in the conditional QDK model
exclusions: Clean zero states are supplied; physical initialization/reset time and faults are not modeled
Classical coefficient handling, compilation, acceptance/readout communication and verification latency are not quantum-model time
QDK uses an empirical mean synthesis fit; no concrete Clifford+T sequence, channel error certificate or runtime-tail bound is supplied
QDK abstracts Clifford scheduling; the source dependency depth is not a physical routed schedule
Reset, intermediate measurement and dynamic-feedback instruments are not costed by this study

phase_evidence.phase_fit_method: deterministic analytic-Jacobian continuation from frozen tau4.1, maxstep.2/max500evals/per-component60s

assumptions: The stated finite-H numerical minimum acceptance is a valid lower bound; it is not formally certified
The QDK mean-fit scalar upper-bounds total variation of the complete final joint data/ancilla distribution
The independently declared ideal algorithm bias bound applies to each conditional Pauli mean
Every independent trial starts with newly supplied clean zero qubits
The declared physical-fault model and classical acceptance/readout interpretation are correct
postselection_contract.proof: For event E, restricted l1 difference a and complement b satisfy |p-q|<=b; conditional TV<=(a+|p-q|)/(2p)<=TV(P,Q)/p

cases.measurement: All wires measured; accept only zero success ancillas, bit0 gives +/-1; every failed complete schedule charged
cases.input_preparation: Fresh clean zero states on all wires assumed; physical initialization not modeled
cases.qasm_global_phase_scope: Measured trial; omitted overall phase does not specify a coherently controlled oracle
cases.size_scaling_scope: n2,n3,n4 at fixed J1,h.7,t1 and output allowance.05; retargeted14/15phases independently checked, no generic phase/size certificate
exclusions: Clean zero states are supplied; physical initialization/reset time and faults are not modeled
Classical coefficient handling, compilation, acceptance/readout communication and verification latency are not quantum-model time
QDK uses an empirical mean synthesis fit; no concrete Clifford+T sequence, channel error certificate or runtime-tail bound is supplied
QDK abstracts Clifford scheduling; the source dependency depth is not a physical routed schedule
Reset, intermediate measurement and dynamic-feedback instruments are not costed by this study

provenance.source_revision_scope: Exact checkout root when Git is available; null for standalone packages. Content hashes identify actual source.
